## - Setting work directories
  
Defining work directory within rmarkdown chunk

```{r setup, include=TRUE}
local_wd_folder = dirname(dirname(dirname(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path)))
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = local_wd_folder)
```

```{r}
setwd(local_wd_folder)
```

## - Setting seed

This step ensures reproducibility in randomized processes

```{r}
set.seed(seed = 123, kind = "Mersenne-Twister", normal.kind = "Inversion")
```

```{r}
options(Seurat.object.assay.version = 'v3')
options(future.globals.maxSize= 891289600*200)
```

## - Loading palettes

```{r}
# Load additional colour palette packages
library(unikn, quietly = TRUE)
library(RColorBrewer, quietly = TRUE)
library(yarrr, quietly = TRUE)
library(scales, quietly = TRUE)
library(ggsci, quietly = TRUE)

# Define a set of custom color palettes from the unikn package
mix_1 <- usecol(pal = c(Karpfenblau, "white", Peach), n = 15)
mix_2 <- usecol(pal = c(rev(pal_seeblau), "white", pal_pinky))
mix_3 <- usecol(pal = c(rev(pal_bordeaux), "white", pal_petrol), n = 15)

# Display the custom palettes
seecol(list(mix_1, mix_2, mix_3), col_brd = "white", lwd_brd = 4, title = "Comparing palettes mixed from unikn colors", pal_names = c("mix_1", "mix_2", "mix_3"))

# Define a second set of custom palettes from the RColorBrewer and yarrr packages
brew_mix <- usecol(c(rev(brewer.pal(n = 4, name = "Reds")), "white", brewer.pal(n = 4, name = "Blues")), n = 13)
brew_ext <- usecol(brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "Spectral"), n = 12)
yarrr_mix <- usecol(c(piratepal("nemo"), piratepal("bugs")))
yarrr_mod <- usecol(c(piratepal("ipod")), n = 9)

gradient_exp <- rev(c('#710D10', '#A21317', brew_mix[1:8], '#E9EBEF'))

# Display the second set of custom palettes
seecol(pal = list(brew_mix, brew_ext, yarrr_mix, yarrr_mod), col_brd = "white", lwd_brd = 2, title = "Using usecol() and seecol() to mix and modify palettes", pal_names = c("brew_mix", "brew_ext", "yarrr_mix", "yarrr_mod"))

# Define additional custom palettes from the scales package
natjournals_palette <- pal_npg("nrc")(10)
```

```{r}
rename_dna_cell_barcodes <- function(
    dna_df,
    sample_id,
    suffix
) {
    barcode <- rownames(dna_df)

    if (is.null(barcode)) {
        stop("DNA data frame has no row names.")
    }

    # Handles both raw barcodes and the previously added PT_IDxx.<barcode>_PTxx form.
    barcode <- sub("^PT_ID[0-9]+(?:_FU)?\\.", "", barcode)
    barcode <- sub("^PT[0-9]+(?:_FU)?\\.PT[0-9]+(?:_FU)?_", "", barcode)
    barcode <- sub("_(PT[0-9]+(?:FU)?)$", "", barcode)

    new_barcodes <- paste0(
        sample_id,
        ".",
        sample_id,
        "_",
        barcode,
        "_",
        suffix
    )

    if (anyDuplicated(new_barcodes)) {
        stop("Duplicate DNA barcodes detected after renaming.")
    }

    rownames(dna_df) <- new_barcodes

    dna_df
}
```

```{r}
dna_samples <- list(
    DNA_PT_ID01 = DNA_PT_ID01,
    DNA_PT_ID02 = DNA_PT_ID02,
    DNA_PT_ID03 = DNA_PT_ID03,
    DNA_PT_ID04 = DNA_PT_ID04,
    DNA_PT_ID05 = DNA_PT_ID05,
    DNA_PT_ID06 = DNA_PT_ID06,
    DNA_PT_ID07 = DNA_PT_ID07,
    DNA_PT_ID08 = DNA_PT_ID08,
    DNA_PT_ID09 = DNA_PT_ID09,
    DNA_PT_ID10 = DNA_PT_ID10,
    DNA_PT_ID11 = DNA_PT_ID11,
    DNA_PT_ID12 = DNA_PT_ID12,
    DNA_PT_ID13 = DNA_PT_ID13,
    DNA_PT_ID14 = DNA_PT_ID14,
    DNA_PT_ID15 = DNA_PT_ID15,
    DNA_PT_ID16 = DNA_PT_ID16,
    DNA_PT_ID17 = DNA_PT_ID17,
    DNA_PT_ID18 = DNA_PT_ID18,
    DNA_PT_ID15_FU = DNA_PT_ID15_FU,
    DNA_PT_ID19 = DNA_PT_ID19,
    DNA_PT_ID20 = DNA_PT_ID20,
    DNA_PT_ID20_FU = DNA_PT_ID20_FU
)

# Union of every aberrancy / variant column across samples.
all_dna_columns <- unique(
    unlist(
        lapply(dna_samples, colnames),
        use.names = FALSE
    )
)

# Keep "label" as the first column.
all_dna_columns <- c(
    "label",
    setdiff(all_dna_columns, "label")
)

dna_samples_aligned <- lapply(
    dna_samples,
    function(df) {
        missing_columns <- setdiff(
            all_dna_columns,
            colnames(df)
        )

        for (column_name in missing_columns) {
            df[[column_name]] <- NA
        }

        df[, all_dna_columns, drop = FALSE]
    }
)

# Verify that cell barcodes remain unique after merging.
all_cell_barcodes <- unlist(
    lapply(dna_samples_aligned, rownames),
    use.names = FALSE
)

if (anyDuplicated(all_cell_barcodes)) {
    stop(
        "Duplicated DNA cell barcodes detected after alignment: ",
        paste(
            unique(all_cell_barcodes[duplicated(all_cell_barcodes)]),
            collapse = ", "
        )
    )
}

# unname() prevents DNA_PT_IDxx from being added as a row-name prefix.
DNA_combined <- do.call(
    rbind,
    unname(dna_samples_aligned)
)

NON_WT_cells <- rownames(DNA_combined)[
    !is.na(DNA_combined$label) &
        DNA_combined$label != "WT"
]
```

```{r}
# For all PT samples, rename 'label' and add missing annotation columns
pt_samples <- list(PT_ID01, PT_ID02, PT_ID03, PT_ID04, PT_ID05, PT_ID06, 
                   PT_ID07, PT_ID08, PT_ID09, PT_ID10, PT_ID11, PT_ID12, 
                   PT_ID13, PT_ID14, PT_ID15, PT_ID16, PT_ID17, PT_ID18, 
                   PT_ID15_FU, PT_ID19, PT_ID20, PT_ID20_FU)

pt_names <- c("PT_ID01", "PT_ID02", "PT_ID03", "PT_ID04", "PT_ID05", "PT_ID06",
              "PT_ID07", "PT_ID08", "PT_ID09", "PT_ID10", "PT_ID11", "PT_ID12",
              "PT_ID13", "PT_ID14", "PT_ID15", "PT_ID16", "PT_ID17", "PT_ID18",
              "PT_ID15_FU", "PT_ID19", "PT_ID20", "PT_ID20_FU")

for (i in seq_along(pt_samples)) {
  if ("label" %in% colnames(pt_samples[[i]])) {
    pt_samples[[i]] <- pt_samples[[i]] %>%
      dplyr::rename(Final_annotation = label)
  }
  if (!"Averaged.Simplified.Celltype" %in% colnames(pt_samples[[i]])) {
    pt_samples[[i]]$Averaged.Simplified.Celltype <- NA
  }
  if (!"Averaged.Detailed.Celltype" %in% colnames(pt_samples[[i]])) {
    pt_samples[[i]]$Averaged.Detailed.Celltype <- NA
  }
  assign(pt_names[i], pt_samples[[i]])
}
```

```{r}
Raw_Base_embedding <- Base_embedding
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(cluster)
library(dplyr)

all_donors <- sort(unique(as.character(Base_embedding$Donor)))
all_donors <- all_donors[!is.na(all_donors) & nzchar(all_donors)]

sample_objects <- list()
silhouette_scores <- list()

for (donor_id in all_donors) {
    message("Processing donor: ", donor_id)

    donor_cells <- colnames(Base_embedding)[
        as.character(Base_embedding$Donor) == donor_id
    ]

    obj <- subset(Base_embedding, cells = donor_cells)

    if (ncol(obj) < 50) {
        message("  Skipping ", donor_id, " — too few cells (", ncol(obj), ")")
        next
    }

    sample_ids <- sort(unique(na.omit(as.character(obj$Sample))))
    timepoints <- sort(unique(na.omit(as.character(obj$Timepoint))))

    DefaultAssay(obj) <- "ADT"

    obj <- NormalizeData(
        obj,
        normalization.method = "CLR",
        margin = 2,
        verbose = FALSE
    )

    obj <- ScaleData(obj, verbose = FALSE)

    obj <- RunPCA(
        obj,
        features = rownames(obj[["ADT"]]),
        verbose = FALSE
    )

    n_dims <- min(10, ncol(Embeddings(obj, "pca")))

    obj <- RunUMAP(
        obj,
        dims = seq_len(n_dims),
        min.dist = 0.1,
        spread = 2,
        n.neighbors = min(50, ncol(obj) - 1),
        seed.use = 42,
        verbose = FALSE
    )

    sample_objects[[donor_id]] <- obj

    annotations <- as.character(obj$Final_annotation)

    valid <- !is.na(annotations) & nzchar(annotations)
    annotation_counts <- table(annotations[valid])

    retained_annotations <- names(annotation_counts[annotation_counts >= 2])

    valid <- valid & annotations %in% retained_annotations

    n_valid_cells <- sum(valid)
    n_celltypes <- length(unique(annotations[valid]))

    if (n_valid_cells >= 20 && n_celltypes >= 2) {
        pca_embed <- Embeddings(obj, "pca")[
            valid,
            seq_len(n_dims),
            drop = FALSE
        ]

        sil <- silhouette(
            as.integer(factor(annotations[valid])),
            dist(pca_embed)
        )

        mean_silhouette <- mean(sil[, "sil_width"], na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
        mean_silhouette <- NA_real_
    }

    silhouette_scores[[donor_id]] <- data.frame(
        Donor = donor_id,
        Samples = paste(sample_ids, collapse = ";"),
        Timepoints = paste(timepoints, collapse = ";"),
        mean_silhouette = mean_silhouette,
        n_cells_total = ncol(obj),
        n_cells_annotated = n_valid_cells,
        n_celltypes = n_celltypes,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
}

sil_df <- bind_rows(silhouette_scores) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_silhouette))

print(sil_df)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Subcluster Erythroblast
# ============================================================
# Follows the same recipe used for the base map (PCA on ADT -> Harmony by
# Sample -> UMAP -> Louvain/Leiden clustering -> marker DEGs), but restricted
# to cells already called 'Erythroblast'. Re-running PCA on the subset rather
# than reusing the whole-object embedding is deliberate: within-erythroblast
# variance is a small fraction of the full dataset's variance, so it would be
# invisible in the first few global PCs.

library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

erythroblast_cells <- WhichCells(Base_embedding, expression = Celltype == 'Erythroblast')
cat("Erythroblast cells:", length(erythroblast_cells), "\n")

Erythroblast_sub <- subset(Base_embedding, cells = erythroblast_cells)

# ---- Re-normalize and re-embed on the subset ---------------------------------
DefaultAssay(Erythroblast_sub) <- "ADT"

Erythroblast_sub <- NormalizeData(
    Erythroblast_sub, normalization.method = 'CLR', margin = 2, verbose = FALSE
)
Erythroblast_sub <- ScaleData(Erythroblast_sub, verbose = FALSE)

set.seed(123)
Erythroblast_sub <- RunPCA(
    Erythroblast_sub, features = rownames(Erythroblast_sub@assays$ADT), verbose = FALSE
)

print(ElbowPlot(Erythroblast_sub))

# ---- Harmony, only if the subset spans more than one sample -----------------
n_samples <- length(unique(na.omit(as.character(Erythroblast_sub$Sample))))
reduction_for_umap <- "pca"

if (n_samples > 1) {
    set.seed(123)
    Erythroblast_sub <- RunHarmony(
        Erythroblast_sub, group.by.vars = 'Sample', dims.use = 1:15, verbose = FALSE
    )
    reduction_for_umap <- "harmony"
} else {
    message("Only one sample present in the Erythroblast subset — skipping Harmony")
}

n_dims <- min(15, ncol(Embeddings(Erythroblast_sub, reduction_for_umap)))

set.seed(123)
Erythroblast_sub <- RunUMAP(
    Erythroblast_sub,
    dims        = 1:n_dims,
    min.dist    = 0.20,
    spread      = 0.5,
    reduction   = reduction_for_umap,
    n.neighbors = min(50, ncol(Erythroblast_sub) - 1),
    seed.use    = 42,
    verbose     = FALSE
)

set.seed(123)
Erythroblast_sub <- FindNeighbors(
    Erythroblast_sub, reduction = reduction_for_umap, dims = 1:n_dims, verbose = FALSE
)

set.seed(123)
Erythroblast_sub <- FindClusters(
    Erythroblast_sub, algorithm = 4, resolution = 1, verbose = FALSE
)

p_sub_clusters <- DimPlot(
    Erythroblast_sub, group.by = 'seurat_clusters', label = TRUE, pt.size = 1.4
) + ggtitle("Erythroblast subclusters")

p_sub_sample <- DimPlot(
    Erythroblast_sub, group.by = 'Sample', pt.size = 1.4
) + ggtitle("By sample")

print(p_sub_clusters | p_sub_sample)

cat("\nCells per subcluster:\n")
print(table(Erythroblast_sub$seurat_clusters))

cat("\nSubcluster composition by sample:\n")
print(table(Erythroblast_sub$seurat_clusters, Erythroblast_sub$Sample))

# ---- Marker DEGs per subcluster ----------------------------------------------
Idents(Erythroblast_sub) <- Erythroblast_sub$seurat_clusters

DEG_erythroblast <- FindAllMarkers(
    Erythroblast_sub, assay = 'ADT', max.cells.per.ident = 1000
)

DEG_erythroblast$pct.1_v_pct.2 <- DEG_erythroblast$pct.1 - DEG_erythroblast$pct.2

feature_col <- intersect(c("gene", "feature"), colnames(DEG_erythroblast))[1]
if (is.na(feature_col)) stop("Could not identify the ADT feature-name column in DEG_erythroblast.")

marker_candidates <- DEG_erythroblast %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
        feature_name = as.character(.data[[feature_col]]),
        cluster = as.character(cluster)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(feature_name), nzchar(feature_name), !is.na(pct.1_v_pct.2)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(cluster, dplyr::desc(pct.1_v_pct.2))

cluster_order <- unique(marker_candidates$cluster)

used_features <- character()
top5_features_by_subcluster <- list()

for (cluster_id in cluster_order) {
    cluster_markers <- marker_candidates %>%
        dplyr::filter(cluster == cluster_id) %>%
        dplyr::filter(!duplicated(feature_name)) %>%
        dplyr::filter(!feature_name %in% used_features)

    selected <- head(cluster_markers, 5)
    if (nrow(selected) == 0) next

    top5_features_by_subcluster[[paste0("Cluster ", cluster_id)]] <- selected$feature_name
    used_features <- c(used_features, selected$feature_name)
}

print(DotPlot(
    Erythroblast_sub, features = top5_features_by_subcluster, assay = "ADT"
) +
    RotatedAxis() +
    ggtitle("Top 5 unique ADT markers per Erythroblast subcluster") +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8)))
```

```{r}
# Only cells belonging to a mapped subcluster get overwritten; everything else
# keeps its existing Celltype ('Erythroblast'). Indexing subcluster_labels[...]
# alone would return NA for unmapped subclusters and blank out those cells.
subcluster_labels <- c(
    "4" = "Plasma"
)

mapped_cells <- rownames(Erythroblast_sub@meta.data)[
    as.character(Erythroblast_sub$seurat_clusters) %in% names(subcluster_labels)
]

Base_embedding@meta.data[mapped_cells, "Celltype"] <-
    subcluster_labels[as.character(Erythroblast_sub$seurat_clusters[mapped_cells])]

cat("Relabelled", length(mapped_cells), "cell(s) as:\n")
print(table(Base_embedding@meta.data[mapped_cells, "Celltype"]))
```

```{r}
Base_embedding <- subset(Base_embedding, cells = high_res_cells)
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(networkD3)

set.seed(123)

Base_embedding <- FindNeighbors(
    Base_embedding,
    reduction = "harmony",
    dims = 1:15,
    k.param = 30,
    graph.name = c("harmony_nn", "harmony_snn")
)

resolutions <- seq(1, 1.5, by = 0.1)

# Fixed IDs used everywhere: 0.50, 0.75, 1.00, 1.25, 1.50
resolution_ids <- sprintf("%.2f", resolutions)
cluster_cols <- paste0("cluster_res_", resolution_ids)

for (i in seq_along(resolutions)) {
    set.seed(123)

    Base_embedding <- FindClusters(
        Base_embedding,
        graph.name = "harmony_snn",
        algorithm = 4,
        resolution = resolutions[i],
        random.seed = 123,
        cluster.name = cluster_cols[i],
        verbose = FALSE
    )
}
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)

# Matches the fixed names created in the clustering loop:
# cluster_res_0.50, cluster_res_0.75, ..., cluster_res_1.50
resolutions <- seq(1, 1.5, by = 0.1)
cluster_cols <- paste0("cluster_res_", sprintf("%.2f", resolutions))

# Retain only clustering columns actually present in metadata.
cluster_cols <- cluster_cols[
    cluster_cols %in% colnames(Base_embedding[[]])
]

resolution_labels <- sub(
    "cluster_res_",
    "Resolution ",
    cluster_cols
)

resolution_plots <- lapply(
    seq_along(cluster_cols),
    function(i) {
        DimPlot(
            Base_embedding,
            group.by = cluster_cols[i],
            label = TRUE,
            repel = TRUE,
            pt.size = 1.4
        ) +
            ggtitle(resolution_labels[i]) +
            theme(
                plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
                legend.position = "none"
            )
    }
)

names(resolution_plots) <- cluster_cols

wrap_plots(
    resolution_plots,
    ncol = 3
) +
    plot_annotation(
        title = "Harmony UMAP across clustering resolutions"
    )
```

# 5. Subclustering

```{r}
Base_embedding$Celltype_revised <- Base_embedding$Celltype
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(harmony)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

run_adt_subclustering <- function(
    main_obj,
    celltype_label,
    n_dims = 10,
    n_neighbors = 15,
    resolution = 1
) {
    DefaultAssay(main_obj) <- "ADT"

    selected_cells <- colnames(main_obj)[
        as.character(main_obj$Celltype) == celltype_label
    ]

    if (length(selected_cells) < 30) {
        stop(
            "Only ", length(selected_cells),
            " cells found for Celltype == '", celltype_label, "'."
        )
    }

    obj <- subset(main_obj, cells = selected_cells)
    DefaultAssay(obj) <- "ADT"

    obj <- NormalizeData(
        obj,
        normalization.method = "CLR",
        margin = 2,
        verbose = FALSE
    )

    obj <- ScaleData(
        obj,
        verbose = FALSE
    )

    set.seed(123)

    obj <- RunPCA(
        obj,
        features = rownames(obj[["ADT"]]),
        verbose = FALSE
    )

    n_pca_dims <- min(
        n_dims,
        ncol(Embeddings(obj, "pca"))
    )

    if (n_pca_dims < 2) {
        stop("Too few PCA dimensions available for subclustering.")
    }

    sample_count <- length(
        unique(na.omit(as.character(obj$Sample)))
    )

    if (sample_count > 1) {
        set.seed(123)

        obj <- RunHarmony(
            obj,
            group.by.vars = "Sample",
            reduction = "pca",
            dims.use = seq_len(n_pca_dims),
            verbose = FALSE
        )

        reduction_use <- "harmony"
        dims_use <- seq_len(
            min(
                n_pca_dims,
                ncol(Embeddings(obj, "harmony"))
            )
        )
    } else {
        reduction_use <- "pca"
        dims_use <- seq_len(n_pca_dims)
    }

    set.seed(123)

    obj <- RunUMAP(
        obj,
        reduction = reduction_use,
        dims = dims_use,
        min.dist = 0.20,
        spread = 1.5,
        n.neighbors = min(n_neighbors, ncol(obj) - 1),
        seed.use = 42,
        return.model = TRUE,
        verbose = FALSE
    )

    set.seed(123)

    obj <- FindNeighbors(
        obj,
        reduction = reduction_use,
        dims = dims_use,
        k.param = min(n_neighbors, ncol(obj) - 1),
        verbose = FALSE
    )

    set.seed(123)

    obj <- FindClusters(
        obj,
        algorithm = 4,
        resolution = resolution,
        random.seed = 123,
        verbose = FALSE
    )

    return(obj)
}


get_adt_marker_outputs <- function(
    obj,
    n_top = 5,
    max_cells_per_ident = 1000
) {
    DefaultAssay(obj) <- "ADT"
    Idents(obj) <- obj$seurat_clusters

    deg <- FindAllMarkers(
        obj,
        assay = "ADT",
        max.cells.per.ident = max_cells_per_ident,
        verbose = FALSE
    )

    if (nrow(deg) == 0) {
        stop("FindAllMarkers returned no ADT markers.")
    }

    deg$pct.1_v_pct.2 <- deg$pct.1 - deg$pct.2

    feature_col <- intersect(c("gene", "feature"), colnames(deg))[1]

    if (length(feature_col) == 0 || is.na(feature_col)) {
        stop("Could not identify the ADT feature-name column in marker results.")
    }

    top20 <- deg %>%
        arrange(cluster, desc(pct.1_v_pct.2)) %>%
        group_by(cluster) %>%
        slice_head(n = 20) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        split(.$cluster)

    marker_candidates <- deg %>%
        mutate(
            feature_name = as.character(.data[[feature_col]]),
            cluster = as.character(cluster)
        ) %>%
        filter(
            !is.na(feature_name),
            nzchar(feature_name),
            !is.na(pct.1_v_pct.2)
        ) %>%
        arrange(cluster, desc(pct.1_v_pct.2))

    cluster_order <- sort(unique(marker_candidates$cluster))

    used_features <- character()
    top_features_by_cluster <- list()
    top_marker_list <- list()

    for (cluster_id in cluster_order) {
        selected_markers <- marker_candidates %>%
            filter(cluster == cluster_id) %>%
            distinct(feature_name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
            filter(!feature_name %in% used_features) %>%
            slice_head(n = n_top)

        if (nrow(selected_markers) == 0) {
            next
        }

        top_features_by_cluster[[paste0("Cluster ", cluster_id)]] <-
            selected_markers$feature_name

        top_marker_list[[cluster_id]] <- selected_markers

        used_features <- c(
            used_features,
            selected_markers$feature_name
        )
    }

    top_markers <- bind_rows(top_marker_list)

    top_dotplot <- DotPlot(
        obj,
        features = top_features_by_cluster,
        assay = "ADT"
    ) +
        RotatedAxis() +
        ggtitle("Top unique ADT markers per subcluster") +
        theme(
            plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
            axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8)
        )

    list(
        DEG = deg,
        top20 = top20,
        top_markers = top_markers,
        dotplot = top_dotplot
    )
}


project_subclusters_to_main <- function(
    main_obj,
    subset_obj,
    population_name,
    reduction = "umap"
) {
    subset_cells <- intersect(
        colnames(subset_obj),
        colnames(main_obj)
    )

    if (length(subset_cells) == 0) {
        stop("No subset cells were found in the main object.")
    }

    refined_clusters <- as.character(
        subset_obj[[]][
            subset_cells,
            "seurat_clusters",
            drop = TRUE
        ]
    )

    metadata_col <- paste0(
        gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", population_name),
        "_subcluster_main"
    )

    main_obj[[metadata_col]] <- "Other cells"

    main_obj@meta.data[
        subset_cells,
        metadata_col
    ] <- paste0(population_name, "_", refined_clusters)

    subcluster_labels <- sort(
        unique(
            main_obj@meta.data[
                subset_cells,
                metadata_col
            ]
        )
    )

    main_obj@meta.data[[metadata_col]] <- factor(
        main_obj@meta.data[[metadata_col]],
        levels = c("Other cells", subcluster_labels)
    )

    plot_cols <- c(
        "Other cells" = "grey85",
        setNames(
            hue_pal()(length(subcluster_labels)),
            subcluster_labels
        )
    )

    p <- DimPlot(
        main_obj,
        reduction = reduction,
        group.by = metadata_col,
        cols = plot_cols,
        order = subcluster_labels,
        shuffle = TRUE,
        seed = 123,
        pt.size = 1.2,
        label = FALSE
    ) +
        ggtitle(
            paste0(
                population_name,
                " subclusters projected onto the main UMAP"
            )
        ) +
        theme(
            plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
        )

    p <- LabelClusters(
        plot = p,
        id = metadata_col,
        clusters = subcluster_labels,
        repel = TRUE,
        box = TRUE,
        size = 4
    )

    list(
        object = main_obj,
        plot = p,
        metadata_column = metadata_col
    )
}
```

# 6. Plasma cells

```{r}
# ============================================================
# mapped_cells — subset, Harmonize, recluster
# ============================================================
# Subsets Base_embedding to exactly the mapped_cells barcodes (Erythroblast
# subcluster 4 from the first run), then re-runs CLR normalization, PCA,
# Harmony integration by Sample, UMAP, and clustering on that subset alone —
# the same recipe used for every other population above.

DefaultAssay(Base_embedding) <- "ADT"

mapped_cells <- intersect(mapped_cells, colnames(Base_embedding))
cat("mapped_cells present in Base_embedding:", length(mapped_cells), "\n")

if (length(mapped_cells) < 30) {
    stop("Only ", length(mapped_cells), " cell(s) in mapped_cells — too few ",
         "for a stable PCA/Harmony/clustering run.")
}

Base_embedding_mapped <- subset(Base_embedding, cells = mapped_cells)
DefaultAssay(Base_embedding_mapped) <- "ADT"

Base_embedding_mapped <- NormalizeData(
    Base_embedding_mapped, normalization.method = "CLR", margin = 2, verbose = FALSE
)
Base_embedding_mapped <- ScaleData(Base_embedding_mapped, verbose = FALSE)

set.seed(123)
Base_embedding_mapped <- RunPCA(
    Base_embedding_mapped, features = rownames(Base_embedding_mapped@assays$ADT),
    verbose = FALSE
)

n_dims <- min(10, ncol(Embeddings(Base_embedding_mapped, "pca")))

n_samples <- length(unique(na.omit(as.character(Base_embedding_mapped$Sample))))
cat("Samples represented:", n_samples, "\n")

if (n_samples > 1) {
    set.seed(123)
    Base_embedding_mapped <- RunHarmony(
        Base_embedding_mapped, group.by.vars = "Sample",
        dims.use = seq_len(n_dims), verbose = FALSE
    )
    reduction_use <- "harmony"
} else {
    message("Only one sample present — skipping Harmony, using PCA directly")
    reduction_use <- "pca"
}

n_neighbors <- min(15, ncol(Base_embedding_mapped) - 1)

set.seed(123)
Base_embedding_mapped <- RunUMAP(
    Base_embedding_mapped,
    reduction    = reduction_use,
    dims         = seq_len(n_dims),
    min.dist     = 0.20,
    spread       = 1.5,
    n.neighbors  = n_neighbors,
    seed.use     = 42,
    return.model = TRUE,
    verbose      = FALSE
)

set.seed(123)
Base_embedding_mapped <- FindNeighbors(
    Base_embedding_mapped, reduction = reduction_use, dims = seq_len(n_dims),
    k.param = n_neighbors, verbose = FALSE
)

set.seed(123)
Base_embedding_mapped <- FindClusters(
    Base_embedding_mapped, algorithm = 4, resolution = 1,
    random.seed = 123, verbose = FALSE
)

DimPlot(
    Base_embedding_mapped, group.by = "Sample", pt.size = 1.4
) + ggtitle("mapped_cells — by sample (post-Harmony)")

DimPlot(
    Base_embedding_mapped, group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = TRUE, pt.size = 1.4
) + ggtitle("mapped_cells — subclusters")

cat("\nCells per subcluster:\n")
print(table(Base_embedding_mapped$seurat_clusters))

cat("\nSubcluster composition by sample:\n")
print(table(Base_embedding_mapped$seurat_clusters, Base_embedding_mapped$Sample))
```

# 7. Re-assignment of noisy cells

```{r}
# ---- 1. Compute silhouette on Harmony space ----
library(cluster)
library(FNN)

harmony_embed <- Embeddings(Base_embedding, 'harmony')[, 1:15]
umap_embed <- Embeddings(Base_embedding, 'umap')

labels <- as.integer(factor(Base_embedding$Celltype_revised))
dist_mat <- dist(harmony_embed)
sil <- silhouette(labels, dist_mat)

Base_embedding$silhouette_score <- sil[, 3]

# ---- 2. Identify outliers per cell type (below Q1 - 1.5*IQR) ----
celltypes <- unique(Base_embedding$Celltype_revised)
low_conf_idx <- c()

for (ct in celltypes) {
  ct_idx <- which(Base_embedding$Celltype_revised == ct)
  ct_scores <- Base_embedding$silhouette_score[ct_idx]
  
  q1 <- quantile(ct_scores, 0.25)
  iqr <- IQR(ct_scores)
  lower_bound <- q1 - 1.5 * iqr
  
  outliers <- ct_idx[ct_scores < lower_bound]
  low_conf_idx <- c(low_conf_idx, outliers)
  
  message(ct, ": ", length(outliers), " outliers out of ", length(ct_idx), 
          " (threshold: ", round(lower_bound, 3), ")")
}

high_conf_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(ncol(Base_embedding)), low_conf_idx)

# ---- 3. Reassign outliers using KNN in UMAP space ----
set.seed(123)
knn_result <- get.knnx(umap_embed[high_conf_idx, , drop = FALSE], 
                        umap_embed[low_conf_idx, , drop = FALSE], k = 15)

new_labels <- apply(knn_result$nn.index, 1, function(nn) {
  neighbour_labels <- Base_embedding$Celltype_revised[high_conf_idx[nn]]
  names(sort(table(neighbour_labels), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
})

Base_embedding$Celltype_revised_refined <- Base_embedding$Celltype_revised
Base_embedding$Celltype_revised_refined[low_conf_idx] <- new_labels

# ---- 4. Per-celltype refinement using UMAP space ----
celltypes_refined <- unique(Base_embedding$Celltype_revised_refined)

for (ct in celltypes_refined) {
  ct_idx <- which(Base_embedding$Celltype_revised_refined == ct)
  
  if (length(ct_idx) < 10) next
  
  ct_embed <- umap_embed[ct_idx, ]
  ct_labels <- Base_embedding$Celltype_revised_refined[ct_idx]
  
  if (length(unique(ct_labels)) < 2) {
    centroid <- colMeans(ct_embed)
    dists <- sqrt(rowSums(sweep(ct_embed, 2, centroid)^2))
    q1 <- quantile(dists, 0.25)
    q3 <- quantile(dists, 0.75)
    iqr <- q3 - q1
    upper_bound <- q3 + 1.5 * iqr
    
    ct_outliers_local <- which(dists > upper_bound)
    
    if (length(ct_outliers_local) > 0) {
      ct_outliers_global <- ct_idx[ct_outliers_local]
      ct_high_conf_global <- setdiff(seq_len(ncol(Base_embedding)), ct_outliers_global)
      ct_high_conf_global <- ct_high_conf_global[Base_embedding$silhouette_score[ct_high_conf_global] >= 0]
      
      if (length(ct_high_conf_global) > 15) {
        set.seed(123)
        knn_fix <- get.knnx(umap_embed[ct_high_conf_global, , drop = FALSE],
                            umap_embed[ct_outliers_global, , drop = FALSE], k = 15)
        
        fix_labels <- apply(knn_fix$nn.index, 1, function(nn) {
          neighbour_labels <- Base_embedding$Celltype_revised_refined[ct_high_conf_global[nn]]
          names(sort(table(neighbour_labels), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
        })
        
        Base_embedding$Celltype_revised_refined[ct_outliers_global] <- fix_labels
      }
    }
  }
}

# ---- 5. Visualise ----
DimPlot(Base_embedding, group.by = 'Celltype_revised', label = TRUE, pt.size = 1.4) + ggtitle('Original')
DimPlot(Base_embedding, group.by = 'Celltype_revised_refined', label = TRUE, pt.size = 1.4) + ggtitle('Refined')

# Summary of changes
table(Original = Base_embedding$Celltype_revised, Refined = Base_embedding$Celltype_revised_refined)
```

```{r}
# Other_T differential expression and top-marker dot plot

DefaultAssay(Base_embedding_Other_Ts) <- "ADT"
Idents(Base_embedding_Other_Ts) <- Base_embedding_Other_Ts$seurat_clusters

DEG_Other_T <- FindAllMarkers(
    Base_embedding_Other_Ts,
    assay = "ADT",
    max.cells.per.ident = 1000
)

DEG_Other_T$pct.1_v_pct.2 <- DEG_Other_T$pct.1 - DEG_Other_T$pct.2

top20_pctdiff_by_cluster_Other_T <- DEG_Other_T %>%
    dplyr::arrange(cluster, dplyr::desc(pct.1_v_pct.2)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(cluster) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 20) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    split(.$cluster)

feature_col <- intersect(c("gene", "feature"), colnames(DEG_Other_T))[1]

marker_candidates_Other_T <- DEG_Other_T %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
        feature_name = as.character(.data[[feature_col]]),
        cluster = as.character(cluster)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
        !is.na(feature_name),
        nzchar(feature_name),
        !is.na(pct.1_v_pct.2)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(cluster, dplyr::desc(pct.1_v_pct.2))

used_features <- character()
top5_features_by_cluster_Other_T <- list()
top5_marker_table_Other_T <- list()

for (cluster_id in sort(unique(marker_candidates_Other_T$cluster))) {
    selected_markers <- marker_candidates_Other_T %>%
        dplyr::filter(cluster == cluster_id) %>%
        dplyr::distinct(feature_name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
        dplyr::filter(!feature_name %in% used_features) %>%
        dplyr::slice_head(n = 5)

    if (nrow(selected_markers) == 0) next

    top5_features_by_cluster_Other_T[[paste0("Other_T cluster ", cluster_id)]] <-
        selected_markers$feature_name

    top5_marker_table_Other_T[[cluster_id]] <- selected_markers
    used_features <- c(used_features, selected_markers$feature_name)
}

top5_pctdiff_by_cluster_Other_T <- dplyr::bind_rows(top5_marker_table_Other_T)

Other_T_top5_dotplot <- DotPlot(
    Base_embedding_Other_Ts,
    features = top5_features_by_cluster_Other_T,
    assay = "ADT"
) +
    RotatedAxis() +
    ggtitle("Top 5 unique ADT markers per Other_T subcluster") +
    theme(
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8)
    )

print(Other_T_top5_dotplot)
```

# 8. Projection of lower quality samples

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggthemes)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 0. Repair sample-level metadata from the terminal barcode suffix.
# Barcode examples:
# PT_ID15_FU.AAC..._PT15FU  -> Sample = PT15_FU, Donor = PT15
# PT_ID20_FU.AAC..._PT20FU  -> Sample = PT20_FU, Donor = PT20
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
extract_terminal_suffix <- function(cell_names) {
    suffix <- sub(
        "^.*_(PT[0-9]+(?:_?FU)?)$",
        "\\1",
        cell_names,
        perl = TRUE
    )

    valid <- grepl(
        "^.*_(PT[0-9]+(?:_?FU)?)$",
        cell_names,
        perl = TRUE
    )

    suffix[!valid] <- NA_character_

    suffix
}

suffix_to_sample <- function(suffix) {
    ifelse(
        grepl("_FU$", suffix),
        suffix,
        sub("FU$", "_FU", suffix)
    )
}

repair_library_metadata <- function(obj) {
    suffix <- extract_terminal_suffix(colnames(obj))

    if (anyNA(suffix)) {
        stop(
            "Could not parse terminal sample suffix from ",
            sum(is.na(suffix)),
            " cell barcodes."
        )
    }

    sample_id <- suffix_to_sample(suffix)

    obj$Sample <- sample_id
    obj$Donor <- sub("_FU$", "", sample_id)
    obj$Timepoint <- ifelse(
        grepl("_FU$", sample_id),
        "Follow-up",
        "Baseline"
    )

    obj
}

Raw_Base_embedding <- repair_library_metadata(Raw_Base_embedding)
Base_embedding <- repair_library_metadata(Base_embedding)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Identify reference and query libraries
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
library_id_col <- "Sample"

ref_libraries <- sort(unique(
    as.character(Base_embedding[[library_id_col, drop = TRUE]])
))

all_libraries <- sort(unique(
    as.character(Raw_Base_embedding[[library_id_col, drop = TRUE]])
))

ref_libraries <- ref_libraries[
    !is.na(ref_libraries) & nzchar(ref_libraries)
]

all_libraries <- all_libraries[
    !is.na(all_libraries) & nzchar(all_libraries)
]

query_libraries <- setdiff(
    all_libraries,
    ref_libraries
)

cat("Reference libraries:\n")
print(ref_libraries)

cat("\nQuery libraries:\n")
print(query_libraries)

cat("\nFollow-up libraries in Raw_Base_embedding:\n")
print(
    intersect(
        c("PT15_FU", "PT20_FU"),
        all_libraries
    )
)

if (length(query_libraries) == 0) {
    stop(
        "No query libraries were found. ",
        "PT15_FU/PT20_FU may already be part of the reference."
    )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Build query_dfs directly from Raw_Base_embedding
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
metadata_cols <- c(
    "Donor",
    "Sample",
    "Condition",
    "Timepoint",
    "Final_annotation",
    "Averaged.Simplified.Celltype",
    "Averaged.Detailed.Celltype",
    "Celltype",
    "Celltype_revised_refined"
)

DefaultAssay(Raw_Base_embedding) <- "ADT"
DefaultAssay(Base_embedding) <- "ADT"

raw_meta <- Raw_Base_embedding[[]]

for (col_name in setdiff(metadata_cols, colnames(raw_meta))) {
    raw_meta[[col_name]] <- NA_character_
}

raw_counts <- GetAssayData(
    Raw_Base_embedding,
    assay = "ADT",
    slot = "counts"
)

query_dfs <- setNames(
    vector("list", length(query_libraries)),
    query_libraries
)

for (sample_id in query_libraries) {
    query_cells <- colnames(Raw_Base_embedding)[
        as.character(
            Raw_Base_embedding[[library_id_col, drop = TRUE]]
        ) == sample_id
    ]

    if (length(query_cells) == 0) {
        next
    }

    query_meta <- raw_meta[
        query_cells,
        metadata_cols,
        drop = FALSE
    ]

    # Enforce corrected sample-level metadata.
    query_meta$Sample <- sample_id
    query_meta$Donor <- sub("_FU$", "", sample_id)
    query_meta$Timepoint <- ifelse(
        grepl("_FU$", sample_id),
        "Follow-up",
        "Baseline"
    )

    query_count_df <- as.data.frame(
        t(as.matrix(raw_counts[, query_cells, drop = FALSE])),
        check.names = FALSE
    )

    rownames(query_count_df) <- query_cells
    rownames(query_meta) <- query_cells

    query_dfs[[sample_id]] <- cbind(
        query_meta,
        query_count_df
    )
}

query_dfs <- Filter(
    Negate(is.null),
    query_dfs
)

if (length(query_dfs) == 0) {
    stop("No query cells were recovered from Raw_Base_embedding.")
}

query_summary <- data.frame(
    Sample = names(query_dfs),
    n_cells = vapply(query_dfs, nrow, integer(1)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

print(query_summary, row.names = FALSE)

# Preserve the original cell names; do not prepend sample IDs.
all_query_cells <- unlist(
    lapply(query_dfs, rownames),
    use.names = FALSE
)

if (anyDuplicated(all_query_cells)) {
    stop("Duplicated cell barcodes detected across query libraries.")
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Identify shared ADT features
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
query_feature_sets <- lapply(
    query_dfs,
    function(df) {
        setdiff(
            colnames(df),
            metadata_cols
        )
    }
)

shared_query_features <- Reduce(
    intersect,
    query_feature_sets
)

shared_features <- intersect(
    shared_query_features,
    rownames(Base_embedding[["ADT"]])
)

if (length(shared_features) < 2) {
    stop(
        "Fewer than two ADT features are shared across all query libraries ",
        "and the reference."
    )
}

message(
    "Using ", length(shared_features),
    " ADT features shared across all query libraries and the reference."
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Align query data frames and build query Seurat object
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
query_dfs_aligned <- lapply(
    names(query_dfs),
    function(sample_id) {
        df <- query_dfs[[sample_id]]

        for (col_name in setdiff(metadata_cols, colnames(df))) {
            df[[col_name]] <- NA_character_
        }

        df$Sample <- sample_id
        df$Donor <- sub("_FU$", "", sample_id)
        df$Timepoint <- ifelse(
            grepl("_FU$", sample_id),
            "Follow-up",
            "Baseline"
        )

        df <- df[
            ,
            c(metadata_cols, shared_features),
            drop = FALSE
        ]

        if (anyDuplicated(rownames(df))) {
            stop(
                "Duplicate cell names detected within query library: ",
                sample_id
            )
        }

        df
    }
)

names(query_dfs_aligned) <- names(query_dfs)

query_merged <- do.call(
    rbind,
    unname(query_dfs_aligned)
)

if (anyDuplicated(rownames(query_merged))) {
    stop("Duplicate cell names created while merging query data frames.")
}

query_counts <- as.matrix(
    query_merged[, shared_features, drop = FALSE]
)

storage.mode(query_counts) <- "numeric"

if (anyNA(query_counts) || any(!is.finite(query_counts))) {
    stop(
        "The aligned query count matrix contains missing or non-numeric ADT values."
    )
}

query_meta <- query_merged[
    ,
    metadata_cols,
    drop = FALSE
]

stopifnot(
    identical(
        rownames(query_counts),
        rownames(query_meta)
    )
)

query_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = t(query_counts),
    assay = "ADT",
    project = "TP53",
    meta.data = query_meta
)

DefaultAssay(query_obj) <- "ADT"

stopifnot(
    identical(
        colnames(query_obj),
        rownames(query_meta)
    )
)

print(
    table(
        query_obj$Sample,
        query_obj$Timepoint,
        useNA = "ifany"
    )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Process query and project onto the reference UMAP
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
query_obj <- NormalizeData(
    query_obj,
    normalization.method = "CLR",
    margin = 2
)

query_obj <- ScaleData(query_obj)

shared_features <- intersect(
    rownames(Base_embedding[["ADT"]]),
    rownames(query_obj[["ADT"]])
)

if (!"pca" %in% Reductions(Base_embedding)) {
    stop("Base_embedding must contain a PCA reduction.")
}

if (!"umap" %in% Reductions(Base_embedding)) {
    stop("Base_embedding must contain a UMAP reduction model.")
}

anchor_dims <- seq_len(
    min(
        15,
        ncol(Embeddings(Base_embedding, "pca"))
    )
)

anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(
    reference = Base_embedding,
    query = query_obj,
    reference.assay = "ADT",
    query.assay = "ADT",
    normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
    reference.reduction = "pca",
    features = shared_features,
    dims = anchor_dims
)

query_obj <- MapQuery(
    anchorset = anchors,
    reference = Base_embedding,
    query = query_obj,
    refdata = list(
        Celltype_revised_refined = "Celltype_revised_refined"
    ),
    reference.reduction = "pca",
    reduction.model = "umap"
)

query_obj$Celltype_revised_refined <- query_obj$predicted.Celltype_revised_refined

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Visualise reference and projected query
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
reference_labels <- sort(
    unique(
        na.omit(
            as.character(Base_embedding$Celltype_revised_refined)
        )
    )
)

tableau20 <- ggthemes_data[["tableau"]]$
    `color-palettes`$
    regular$
    `Classic 20`$
    value

color_map <- setNames(
    tableau20[
        (seq_along(reference_labels) - 1) %% length(tableau20) + 1
    ],
    reference_labels
)

reference_umap <- as.data.frame(
    Embeddings(Base_embedding, "umap")
)

colnames(reference_umap) <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")

reference_umap$Celltype <- as.character(
    Base_embedding$Celltype_revised_refined
)

query_umap <- as.data.frame(
    Embeddings(query_obj, "ref.umap")
)

colnames(query_umap) <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")

query_umap$Celltype <- as.character(
    query_obj$predicted.Celltype_revised_refined
)

p1 <- ggplot(
    reference_umap,
    aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, fill = Celltype)
) +
    geom_point(
        shape = 21,
        size = 1.6,
        stroke = 0.3,
        color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
        values = color_map,
        na.value = "grey80"
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    ggtitle("Reference") +
    theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.title = element_blank()
    ) +
    NoLegend()

p2 <- ggplot(
    query_umap,
    aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, fill = Celltype)
) +
    geom_point(
        shape = 21,
        size = 1.6,
        stroke = 0.3,
        color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
        values = color_map,
        na.value = "grey80"
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    ggtitle("Query projected") +
    theme(
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.title = element_blank()
    ) +
    NoLegend()

p1 + p2

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Check prediction confidence
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
confidence_feature <- if (
    "prediction.score.max" %in% colnames(query_obj[[]])
) {
    "prediction.score.max"
} else {
    grep(
        "^prediction.score",
        colnames(query_obj[[]]),
        value = TRUE
    )[1]
}

if (!is.na(confidence_feature)) {
    FeaturePlot(
        query_obj,
        features = confidence_feature,
        reduction = "ref.umap"
    ) +
        ggtitle("Prediction confidence")
}

# Confirm FU samples survived into the projected query.
table(
    query_obj$Sample,
    query_obj$Timepoint,
    useNA = "ifany"
)
```

```{r}
# Get UMAP coordinates
ref_umap <- Embeddings(Base_embedding, 'umap')
query_umap <- Embeddings(query_obj, 'ref.umap')

# For each query cell, find nearest reference neighbours
knn_result <- get.knnx(ref_umap, query_umap, k = 15)

# Compute mean distance to k nearest neighbours
mean_dists <- rowMeans(knn_result$nn.dist)

# Relaxed threshold — use median + 5*IQR instead of Q3 + 1.5*IQR
median_dist <- median(mean_dists)
iqr <- IQR(mean_dists)
dist_threshold <- median_dist + 5 * iqr

message("Distance threshold: ", round(dist_threshold, 3))
message("Cells within threshold: ", sum(mean_dists <= dist_threshold), " / ", length(mean_dists))

# Majority vote from reference neighbours
knn_labels <- apply(knn_result$nn.index, 1, function(nn) {
  neighbour_labels <- Base_embedding$Celltype_revised_refined[nn]
  names(sort(table(neighbour_labels), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
})

# Only assign if within distance threshold, otherwise keep predicted label
query_obj$Celltype_revised_refined <- ifelse(
  mean_dists <= dist_threshold,
  knn_labels,
  query_obj$predicted.Celltype_revised_refined
)

# Flag scattered cells
query_obj$projection_confident <- mean_dists <= dist_threshold
```

# 9. Projection of lower quality data

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggthemes)
library(patchwork)

# ---- 1. Build the low-resolution query from cell barcodes ----

DefaultAssay(Base_embedding) <- "ADT"
DefaultAssay(Raw_Base_embedding) <- "ADT"

low_res_cells <- unique(as.character(low_res_cells))

cells_found_in_raw <- intersect(
    low_res_cells,
    colnames(Raw_Base_embedding)
)

cells_missing_from_raw <- setdiff(
    low_res_cells,
    colnames(Raw_Base_embedding)
)

cells_already_in_reference <- intersect(
    cells_found_in_raw,
    colnames(Base_embedding)
)

query_cells <- setdiff(
    cells_found_in_raw,
    colnames(Base_embedding)
)

message("Low-resolution barcodes supplied: ", length(low_res_cells))
message("Found in Raw_Base_embedding: ", length(cells_found_in_raw))
message("Already in reference, not re-projected: ", length(cells_already_in_reference))
message("Query cells to project: ", length(query_cells))
message("Barcodes missing from Raw_Base_embedding: ", length(cells_missing_from_raw))

if (length(query_cells) < 10) {
    stop(
        "Fewer than 10 low-resolution cells remain for projection. ",
        "Check that low_res_cells matches colnames(Raw_Base_embedding)."
    )
}

query_obj <- subset(
    Raw_Base_embedding,
    cells = query_cells
)

DefaultAssay(query_obj) <- "ADT"

# Metadata from Raw_Base_embedding is retained automatically.
query_obj$projection_group <- "Low-resolution projected"

# ---- 2. Restrict to ADTs shared between reference and query ----

shared_features <- intersect(
    rownames(Base_embedding[["ADT"]]),
    rownames(query_obj[["ADT"]])
)

if (length(shared_features) < 2) {
    stop("Fewer than two ADT features are shared between query and reference.")
}

message(
    "Shared ADT features used for mapping: ",
    length(shared_features)
)

# ---- 3. Process query ADT counts ----

query_obj <- NormalizeData(
    query_obj,
    normalization.method = "CLR",
    margin = 2,
    verbose = FALSE
)

query_obj <- ScaleData(
    query_obj,
    features = shared_features,
    verbose = FALSE
)

# ---- 4. Find anchors and project onto the reference UMAP ----

n_dims <- min(
    15,
    ncol(Embeddings(Base_embedding, "pca")),
    ncol(Embeddings(Base_embedding, "harmony")),
    length(shared_features)
)

if (n_dims < 2) {
    stop("Fewer than two usable dimensions are available for mapping.")
}

anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(
    reference = Base_embedding,
    query = query_obj,
    reference.assay = "ADT",
    query.assay = "ADT",
    normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
    reference.reduction = "pca",
    features = shared_features,
    dims = seq_len(n_dims)
)

query_obj <- MapQuery(
    anchorset = anchors,
    reference = Base_embedding,
    query = query_obj,
    refdata = list(
        Celltype_revised_refined = "Celltype_revised_refined"
    ),
    reference.reduction = "pca",
    reduction.model = "umap"
)

query_obj$Celltype_revised_refined <-
    query_obj$predicted.Celltype_revised_refined
```

```{r}
# Get UMAP coordinates
ref_umap <- Embeddings(Base_embedding, 'umap')
query_umap <- Embeddings(query_obj, 'ref.umap')

# For each query cell, find nearest reference neighbours
knn_result <- get.knnx(ref_umap, query_umap, k = 15)

# Compute mean distance to k nearest neighbours
mean_dists <- rowMeans(knn_result$nn.dist)

# Relaxed threshold — use median + 5*IQR instead of Q3 + 1.5*IQR
median_dist <- median(mean_dists)
iqr <- IQR(mean_dists)
dist_threshold <- median_dist + 5 * iqr

message("Distance threshold: ", round(dist_threshold, 3))
message("Cells within threshold: ", sum(mean_dists <= dist_threshold), " / ", length(mean_dists))

# Majority vote from reference neighbours
knn_labels <- apply(knn_result$nn.index, 1, function(nn) {
  neighbour_labels <- Base_embedding$Celltype_revised_refined[nn]
  names(sort(table(neighbour_labels), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
})

# Only assign if within distance threshold, otherwise keep predicted label
query_obj$Celltype_revised_refined <- ifelse(
  mean_dists <= dist_threshold,
  knn_labels,
  query_obj$predicted.Celltype_revised_refined
)

# Flag scattered cells
query_obj$projection_confident <- mean_dists <= dist_threshold
```

# 11. Final merge

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# Reference manifold and projected low-quality query cells.
reference_obj <- combined_lower_quality_pts
query_obj <- combined_lower_quality_cell_cluster

DefaultAssay(reference_obj) <- "ADT"
DefaultAssay(query_obj) <- "ADT"

# Use the query reduction created by MapQuery when available.
reference_reduction <- "umap"
query_reduction <- if ("ref.umap" %in% Reductions(query_obj)) {
    "ref.umap"
} else {
    "umap"
}

# ---- 1. Keep reference cells once; append only query-exclusive cells ----

reference_cells <- colnames(reference_obj)
query_cells <- colnames(query_obj)

overlap_cells <- intersect(reference_cells, query_cells)
query_only_cells <- setdiff(query_cells, reference_cells)

message("Reference cells: ", length(reference_cells))
message("Query cells supplied: ", length(query_cells))
message("Overlapping cells retained from reference only: ", length(overlap_cells))
message("Query-exclusive cells appended: ", length(query_only_cells))

if (length(query_only_cells) == 0) {
    stop("All query cells already exist in the reference object; nothing new to append.")
}

query_obj_unique <- subset(
    query_obj,
    cells = query_only_cells
)

# Ensure query labels are available in the merged object.
if (
    !"Celltype_revised_refined" %in% colnames(query_obj_unique[[]]) &&
    "predicted.Celltype_revised_refined" %in% colnames(query_obj_unique[[]])
) {
    query_obj_unique$Celltype_revised_refined <-
        query_obj_unique$predicted.Celltype_revised_refined
}

# ---- 2. Extract only non-overlapping query UMAP coordinates ----

ref_umap <- Embeddings(reference_obj, reference_reduction)

query_umap <- Embeddings(
    query_obj_unique,
    query_reduction
)

colnames(query_umap) <- colnames(ref_umap)

combined_umap <- rbind(
    ref_umap,
    query_umap
)

if (anyDuplicated(rownames(combined_umap))) {
    stop("Duplicate cell barcodes remain in the combined UMAP coordinates.")
}

# ---- 3. Merge expression and metadata without duplicate cells ----

combined <- merge(
    x = reference_obj,
    y = query_obj_unique,
    merge.data = TRUE
)

DefaultAssay(combined) <- "ADT"

# Match UMAP rows exactly to the merged Seurat object cell order.
combined_umap <- combined_umap[
    colnames(combined),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
]

if (anyNA(combined_umap)) {
    stop("Missing UMAP coordinates detected after merging.")
}

# Replace the merged object's UMAP with the saved reference + projected-query coordinates.
combined[["umap"]] <- CreateDimReducObject(
    embeddings = combined_umap,
    key = "UMAP_",
    assay = "ADT"
)

# Mark provenance.
combined$source <- ifelse(
    colnames(combined) %in% query_only_cells,
    "Projected low-quality query",
    "Reference"
)

# ---- 4. Visualise ----

p1 <- DimPlot(
    combined,
    reduction = "umap",
    group.by = "Celltype_revised_refined",
    label = TRUE,
    repel = TRUE,
    pt.size = 0.8
) +
    ggtitle("Cell types") +
    NoLegend()

p2 <- DimPlot(
    combined,
    reduction = "umap",
    group.by = "source",
    pt.size = 0.8,
    cols = c(
        "Reference" = "grey75",
        "Projected low-quality query" = "tomato"
    )
) +
    ggtitle("Reference and projected low-quality cells")

p3 <- DimPlot(
    combined,
    reduction = "umap",
    group.by = "Sample",
    pt.size = 0.8
) +
    ggtitle("Sample")

p1 + p2 + p3

# ---- 5. Checks ----

table(combined$source)

table(
    combined$Celltype_revised_refined,
    combined$source,
    useNA = "ifany"
)

length(intersect(
    colnames(reference_obj),
    colnames(query_obj_unique)
))
```

# 12. Viz

## - Panel D

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(colorspace)

umap_df <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(combined, "umap"))

color_map <- c(
    "B cell"            = "#B07AA1",
    "Plasma cell"   = "#8CD17D",
    "CD14+ monocyte"    = "#F28E2B",
    "CD16+ monocyte"    = "#FFBE7D",
    "Mono/Macrophage"   = "#5A5A5A",
    "CD4+ T cell"       = "#9D7660",
    "CD8+ T cell"       = "#514DAD",
    "cDC"               = "#F1CE63",
    "pDC"               = "#86BCB6",
    "NK cell"           = "#FABFD2",
    "Erythroblast"      = "#E15759",
    "HSPC"              = "#4E79A7",
    "Other T cell"      = "#BAB0AC"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Outline colour: DARKENED (not lightened) so individual point
# boundaries stay visible against overlapping neighbours. Darkened
# further this round (0.35 -> 0.5) since larger points with a heavier
# stroke need more contrast to read as distinct circles rather than a
# fused mass at their edges.
# ------------------------------------------------------------
color_map_dark <- darken(color_map, amount = 0.5)
names(color_map_dark) <- names(color_map)

# Factor with explicit levels => legend follows color_map order (not alphabetical),
# and any label missing from color_map surfaces immediately rather than plotting grey.
umap_df$Celltype <- factor(combined$Celltype_revised_refined, levels = names(color_map))
stopifnot(!anyNA(umap_df$Celltype))   # fail loudly if a label has no colour

celltype_counts <- table(umap_df$Celltype)
abundance_order <- names(sort(celltype_counts, decreasing = TRUE))  # most -> least abundant

umap_df <- umap_df[order(match(umap_df$Celltype, abundance_order)), , drop = FALSE]

cat("Draw order (bottom to top, i.e. most to least abundant):\n")
print(celltype_counts[abundance_order])

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Alpha scaled by abundance -- ABUNDANT types get LOWER alpha (so
# overlapping points in dense clusters show through each other),
# RARE types get alpha near 1. Range widened slightly (0.35-0.95 ->
# 0.28-0.95) since larger points overlap MORE at a given density, so
# the most-abundant end needs to go a bit lower to keep individual
# cells distinguishable.
# ------------------------------------------------------------
ALPHA_RANGE <- c(0.28, 0.95)

abundance_rank <- rank(-celltype_counts[names(color_map)], ties.method = "average")
normalized_rank <- (abundance_rank - 1) / (length(abundance_rank) - 1)
alpha_map <- ALPHA_RANGE[1] + normalized_rank * diff(ALPHA_RANGE)
names(alpha_map) <- names(color_map)

cat("\nAlpha by cell type (low = abundant, high = rare):\n")
print(round(sort(alpha_map), 3))

p <- ggplot(umap_df, aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2)) +
    geom_point(
        aes(fill = Celltype, color = Celltype, alpha = Celltype),
        shape  = 21,
        size   = 2,    # increased from 2 -- larger individual points
        stroke = 0.40    # increased from 0.18 -- heavier outline scales
                         # with the larger point size, keeping edges crisp
                         # rather than proportionally thinner
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = color_map) +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_map_dark) +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = alpha_map, guide = "none") +
    theme_void(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
        plot.margin       = margin(10, 10, 10, 10),
        legend.position   = "bottom",
        legend.text       = element_text(size = 9),
        legend.title      = element_blank(),
        legend.key.size   = unit(0.9, "lines"),
        legend.margin     = margin(t = 6)
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(
        ncol         = 4,
        override.aes = list(size = 4, stroke = 0.3, alpha = 1)
    ))

p_no_legend <- p + theme(legend.position = "none")

save_dir <- "/project/meadlab/shared/02__Projects/02b__Tapestri/results/figures"
dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave(file.path(save_dir, "Fig_1D.pdf"),
    plot = p, width = 6.25, height = 5.75, device = cairo_pdf)
ggsave(file.path(save_dir, "Fig_1D.png"),
    plot = p, width = 6.25, height = 5.75, dpi = 300)
```

## - Fig S1

```{r}
# ---- packages ----
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(Seurat)
    library(ggplot2)
    library(dplyr)
    library(ggdendro)
    library(scales)
    library(grid)
    library(gtable)
    library(RColorBrewer)
})

# ---- setup ----
DefaultAssay(combined) <- "ADT"

genes_use    <- rownames(combined[["ADT"]])
gradient_exp <- rev(brewer.pal(9, "RdBu"))
pad          <- 0.6

color_map <- c(
    "B cell"            = "#B07AA1",
    "Plasma cell"   = "#8CD17D",
    "CD14+ monocyte"    = "#F28E2B",
    "CD16+ monocyte"    = "#FFBE7D",
    "Mono/Macrophage"   = "#5A5A5A",
    "CD4+ T cell"       = "#9D7660",
    "CD8+ T cell"       = "#514DAD",
    "cDC"               = "#F1CE63",
    "pDC"               = "#86BCB6",
    "NK cell"           = "#FABFD2",
    "Erythroblast"      = "#E15759",
    "HSPC"              = "#4E79A7",
    "Other T cell"      = "#BAB0AC"
)

# -------------------------------------------------
# Build DotPlot data
# -------------------------------------------------
dp_raw <- DotPlot(
    combined,
    assay     = "ADT",
    group.by  = "Celltype_revised_refined",
    scale.by  = "radius",
    dot.scale = 12,
    features  = genes_use
)$data %>%
    mutate(
        features.plot = trimws(as.character(features.plot)),
        id            = trimws(as.character(id))
    )

celltypes_dp <- sort(unique(dp_raw$id))
celltypes_dp <- celltypes_dp[
    !is.na(celltypes_dp) &
        celltypes_dp != ""
]

genes_dp <- intersect(
    genes_use,
    sort(unique(dp_raw$features.plot))
)

# -------------------------------------------------
# Average expression and clustering
# -------------------------------------------------
avg_mat <- AverageExpression(
    combined,
    assays   = "ADT",
    features = genes_dp,
    group.by = "Celltype_revised_refined",
    slot     = "data",
    verbose  = FALSE
)$ADT

colnames(avg_mat) <- trimws(colnames(avg_mat))
rownames(avg_mat) <- trimws(rownames(avg_mat))

avg_mat <- avg_mat[
    genes_dp,
    celltypes_dp,
    drop = FALSE
]

avg_scaled <- t(scale(t(avg_mat)))
avg_scaled[is.na(avg_scaled)] <- 0

hc_genes <- hclust(
    dist(avg_scaled),
    method = "ward.D2"
)

d_genes <- as.dendrogram(hc_genes)

hc_ct <- hclust(
    dist(t(avg_scaled)),
    method = "ward.D2"
)

d_ct <- as.dendrogram(hc_ct)

# -------------------------------------------------
# Leaf positions
# -------------------------------------------------
dd_g <- ggdendro::dendro_data(
    d_genes,
    type = "rectangle"
)

dd_c <- ggdendro::dendro_data(
    d_ct,
    type = "rectangle"
)

gene_leaves <- dd_g$labels %>%
    mutate(label = trimws(as.character(label))) %>%
    arrange(x)

gene_order <- gene_leaves$label
gene_pos <- setNames(
    gene_leaves$x,
    gene_leaves$label
)

n_genes <- length(gene_order)

ct_leaves <- dd_c$labels %>%
    mutate(label = trimws(as.character(label))) %>%
    arrange(x)

celltype_order <- ct_leaves$label
ct_pos <- setNames(
    ct_leaves$x,
    ct_leaves$label
)

n_ct <- length(celltype_order)

# -------------------------------------------------
# Dot plot data
# -------------------------------------------------
dp <- dp_raw %>%
    filter(
        features.plot %in% gene_order,
        id %in% celltype_order
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        x = ct_pos[id],
        y = gene_pos[features.plot]
    ) %>%
    filter(
        !is.na(x),
        !is.na(y)
    )

vlines <- data.frame(
    xv = head(sort(ct_pos), -1) +
        diff(sort(ct_pos)) / 2
)

hlines <- data.frame(
    yv = head(sort(gene_pos), -1) +
        diff(sort(gene_pos)) / 2
)

x_lim <- c(
    min(ct_pos) - pad,
    max(ct_pos) + pad
)

y_lim <- c(
    min(gene_pos) - pad,
    max(gene_pos) + pad
)

# -------------------------------------------------
# Main dot plot
# Solid shape 16 has no border/stroke in PDF.
# -------------------------------------------------
DotP <- ggplot(dp, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
    geom_vline(
        data = vlines,
        aes(xintercept = xv),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        linetype = "dashed",
        colour = "grey70",
        linewidth = 0.3
    ) +
    geom_hline(
        data = hlines,
        aes(yintercept = yv),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        linetype = "dashed",
        colour = "grey70",
        linewidth = 0.3
    ) +
    geom_point(
        aes(
            size = pct.exp,
            colour = avg.exp.scaled
        ),
        shape = 16,
        alpha = 1,
        na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_colour_gradientn(
        colours = gradient_exp
    ) +
    scale_size(
        limits = c(0, 100),
        range = c(0.5, 6),
        breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
        labels = function(z) paste0(z, "%")
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
        breaks = ct_pos,
        labels = names(ct_pos),
        limits = x_lim,
        expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
        breaks = gene_pos,
        labels = names(gene_pos),
        limits = y_lim,
        expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_bw(
        base_size = 12,
        base_line_size = 0.2
    ) +
    theme(
        text = element_text(family = "sans"),
        plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(
            angle = 45,
            hjust = 1,
            vjust = 1,
            size = 10,
            family = "sans"
        ),
        axis.text.y = element_text(
            size = 10,
            family = "sans"
        ),
        axis.line = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.justification = "center",
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.box = "horizontal",
        legend.box.just = "top",
        legend.spacing.x = unit(1.5, "cm"),
        legend.box.spacing = unit(0.2, "cm"),
        legend.margin = margin(t = 5, b = 5, l = 0, r = 0),
        legend.text = element_text(
            size = 9,
            family = "sans"
        ),
        legend.title = element_text(
            size = 10,
            family = "sans"
        ),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
        legend.key.spacing.x = unit(0.1, "cm")
    ) +
    guides(
        colour = guide_colorbar(
            title = "Scaled Expression",
            title.position = "top",
            title.hjust = 0.5,
            barwidth = unit(4, "cm"),
            barheight = unit(0.35, "cm"),
            ticks.linewidth = 0.3,
            frame.colour = "black",
            frame.linewidth = 0.3,
            order = 2
        ),
        size = guide_legend(
            title = "Percent Expressing",
            title.position = "top",
            title.hjust = 0.5,
            nrow = 1,
            byrow = TRUE,
            override.aes = list(
                shape = 16,
                colour = "grey70"
            ),
            order = 1
        )
    )

# -------------------------------------------------
# Convert to gtable
# -------------------------------------------------
g_dot <- ggplotGrob(DotP)

panel_idx <- which(g_dot$layout$name == "panel")

panel_t <- g_dot$layout$t[panel_idx]
panel_b <- g_dot$layout$b[panel_idx]
panel_l <- g_dot$layout$l[panel_idx]
panel_r <- g_dot$layout$r[panel_idx]

# -------------------------------------------------
# Celltype color strip
# -------------------------------------------------
axisb_idx <- which(g_dot$layout$name == "axis-b")
axisb_row <- g_dot$layout$t[axisb_idx]

strip_rects <- lapply(
    celltype_order,
    function(ct) {
        x0 <- rescale(
            ct_pos[ct] - 0.5,
            from = x_lim
        )

        x1 <- rescale(
            ct_pos[ct] + 0.5,
            from = x_lim
        )

        rectGrob(
            x = unit(x0, "npc"),
            y = unit(0, "npc"),
            width = unit(x1 - x0, "npc"),
            height = unit(1, "npc"),
            just = c("left", "bottom"),
            gp = gpar(
                fill = color_map[ct],
                col = NA
            )
        )
    }
)

strip_grob <- gTree(
    children = do.call(gList, strip_rects)
)

g_dot <- gtable_add_rows(
    g_dot,
    heights = unit(0.12, "in"),
    pos = axisb_row - 1
)

g_dot <- gtable_add_grob(
    g_dot,
    strip_grob,
    t = axisb_row,
    b = axisb_row,
    l = panel_l,
    r = panel_r,
    name = "color_strip"
)

# -------------------------------------------------
# Top dendrogram: cell types
# -------------------------------------------------
dend_top_grob <- gTree(
    children = gList(
        segmentsGrob(
            x0 = unit(
                rescale(
                    dd_c$segments$x,
                    from = x_lim
                ),
                "npc"
            ),
            y0 = unit(
                rescale(
                    dd_c$segments$y,
                    from = c(
                        0,
                        max(dd_c$segments$y)
                    )
                ),
                "npc"
            ),
            x1 = unit(
                rescale(
                    dd_c$segments$xend,
                    from = x_lim
                ),
                "npc"
            ),
            y1 = unit(
                rescale(
                    dd_c$segments$yend,
                    from = c(
                        0,
                        max(dd_c$segments$y)
                    )
                ),
                "npc"
            ),
            gp = gpar(lwd = 0.8)
        )
    )
)

# -------------------------------------------------
# Right dendrogram: markers
# -------------------------------------------------
dend_right_grob <- gTree(
    children = gList(
        segmentsGrob(
            x0 = unit(
                rescale(
                    dd_g$segments$y,
                    from = c(
                        0,
                        max(dd_g$segments$y)
                    )
                ),
                "npc"
            ),
            y0 = unit(
                rescale(
                    dd_g$segments$x,
                    from = y_lim
                ),
                "npc"
            ),
            x1 = unit(
                rescale(
                    dd_g$segments$yend,
                    from = c(
                        0,
                        max(dd_g$segments$y)
                    )
                ),
                "npc"
            ),
            y1 = unit(
                rescale(
                    dd_g$segments$xend,
                    from = y_lim
                ),
                "npc"
            ),
            gp = gpar(lwd = 0.8)
        )
    )
)

# -------------------------------------------------
# Add dendrograms to gtable
# -------------------------------------------------
g_combined <- gtable_add_rows(
    g_dot,
    heights = unit(0.1, "in"),
    pos = 0
)

g_combined <- gtable_add_rows(
    g_combined,
    heights = unit(1.5, "in"),
    pos = 0
)

g_combined <- gtable_add_rows(
    g_combined,
    heights = unit(0.1, "in"),
    pos = 0
)

g_combined <- gtable_add_grob(
    g_combined,
    dend_top_grob,
    t = 2,
    b = 2,
    l = panel_l,
    r = panel_r,
    name = "dend_top"
)

g_combined <- gtable_add_cols(
    g_combined,
    widths = unit(0.1, "in"),
    pos = -1
)

g_combined <- gtable_add_cols(
    g_combined,
    widths = unit(0.8, "in"),
    pos = -1
)

g_combined <- gtable_add_cols(
    g_combined,
    widths = unit(0.1, "in"),
    pos = -1
)

g_combined <- gtable_add_grob(
    g_combined,
    dend_right_grob,
    t = panel_t + 3,
    b = panel_b + 3,
    l = ncol(g_combined) - 1,
    r = ncol(g_combined) - 1,
    name = "dend_right"
)

# -------------------------------------------------
# Preview
# -------------------------------------------------
plot_w <- max(8, n_ct * 0.35 + 4)
plot_h <- max(12, n_genes * 0.35 + 4)

grid.newpage()
grid.draw(g_combined)

# -------------------------------------------------
# Save
# -------------------------------------------------
save_dir <- "/project/meadlab/shared/02__Projects/02b__Tapestri/results/figures"

dir.create(
    save_dir,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
)

cairo_pdf(
    filename = file.path(
        save_dir,
        "Fig_S1.pdf"
    ),
    width = plot_w,
    height = plot_h
)

grid.newpage()
grid.draw(g_combined)
dev.off()

png(
    filename = file.path(
        save_dir,
        "Fig_S1.png"
    ),
    width = plot_w,
    height = plot_h,
    units = "in",
    res = 300,
    type = "cairo"
)

grid.newpage()
grid.draw(g_combined)
dev.off()
```
